name: Sliding Sessionization with Absolute Maximum Duration Cap
description: Real-world web sessions often need dual constraints: a 30-minute inactivity timeout AND a strict maximum 4-hour absolute session duration to prevent bots from maintaining endless sessions.
prompt:
Real-world web sessions often need dual constraints: a 30-minute inactivity timeout AND a strict maximum 4-hour absolute session duration to prevent bots from maintaining endless sessions.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: user_id, event_time, action, raw_session_id, minutes_since_session_start.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Partition sessions by inactivity (>30m) OR exceeding 4 hours from session start
            WITH ranked_events AS (
                SELECT 
                    user_id,
                    event_time,
                    action,
                    LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS prev_time
                FROM bot_events
            ),
            step_flags AS (
                SELECT 
                    user_id,
                    event_time,
                    action,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev_time IS NULL THEN 1
                        WHEN date_diff('minute', prev_time, event_time) > 30 THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS gap_split
                FROM ranked_events
            ),
            base_sessions AS (
                SELECT 
                    *,
                    SUM(gap_split) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_time) AS raw_session_id
                FROM step_flags
            )
            SELECT 
                user_id,
                event_time,
                action,
                raw_session_id,
                -- Measure elapsed minutes from session genesis
                date_diff('minute', 
                    FIRST_VALUE(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, raw_session_id ORDER BY event_time),
                    event_time
                ) AS minutes_since_session_start
            FROM base_sessions
            ORDER BY user_id, event_time;
why_it_fails: A simple inactivity check keeps sessions alive indefinitely if events happen every 10 minutes. Tracking session origin requires window frames with state.
